source_policy: Derived corpus statistics only; original Softimage assets are not committed.
priority: Asset reconstruction fidelity: geometry, hierarchy, transforms, UVs, texture placement and tiling. Historical floor/render lighting matching is not a gate for this stage.

model_local_code400.implementation_consequence: Every resolved model-local projection can use the working 1..5 fitted-support UV generator without first solving non-identity +90 matrix direction. The generator now applies recovered URepeat/VRepeat before +6 scale/offset and crop; this materially fixes texture density on 304/403 model-local projection edges. Source UVs remain preserved as a separate map/provenance path.

material_level_code401.implementation_consequence: Identity-matrix code-401 layers with working projection codes can receive generated per-object UV maps immediately. Portable base textures and generated projections now include recovered repeat counts plus confirmed +6 scale/offset and crop. Non-identity matrix layers remain the main transform-direction frontier.

7.working_status: reflection/environment-associated special material mode; not forced through geometric UV projection

8.working_status: glass/environment-associated special material mode; not forced through geometric UV projection

portable_gltf.all_zero_uv_policy: Annotate all-zero polygon UVs as projection-dependent when model-local code-400 state exists; do not pretend they are a usable authored unwrap.
portable_gltf.nurbs_uv_policy: Keep normalized NURBS parameter-space UVs explicitly distinguished from recovered source texture projection.
portable_gltf.material_texture_transform: Recovered SI_Texture2D URepeat/VRepeat, confirmed +6 U/V scale+offset, and source-pixel crop are composed into KHR_texture_transform for the portable base texture when non-identity.

blender.generated_uv_policy: Create additive named BZ2 projection UV maps per recoverable texture/operator and apply URepeat/VRepeat before +6 placement/crop.
blender.model_local_texture_policy: Expose mapped model-local base/bump texture nodes per object; auto-connect a base only when no other Base Color texture stack is already connected.
blender.material_layer_policy: Rewire supported identity-matrix layers to generated UV maps; unresolved operators/matrix direction retain explicit source state rather than being promoted as authoritative projection UVs.
blender.cross_scope_blending: Preserve model-local and material-level texture nodes without inventing an unproven blend order when both exist.

remaining_asset_fidelity_frontier: non-identity +90 matrix direction for material-level code-401 projection layers
exact model-local/material-level texture composition where both contribute to one material
authoritative UAlternate/VAlternate/UVSwap behavior when non-default source anchors are found
exact Blender equivalents for special material modes 7 and 8
